channel.title: Cyber Threat Wall — Latest Movers
channel.description: Actively exploited vulnerabilities rising fastest in Cyber Threat Wall rankings.

item.title: CVE-2024-27834 — Apple Multiple Products
item.description: Threat Signal 60. Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-48356 — Adobe Commerce and Magento
item.description: Threat Signal 75. Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

item.title: CVE-2026-111497 — Google Brotli
item.description: Threat Signal 82. Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

item.title: CVE-2020-25079 — D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. D-Link DCS-2530L and DCS-2670L devices contains a command injection vulnerability in the cgi-bin/ddns_enc.cgi. The impacted products could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users should discontinue product utilization.

item.title: CVE-2023-44221 — SonicWall SMA100 Appliances
item.description: Threat Signal 69. SonicWall SMA100 appliances contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the SSL-VPN management interface that allows a remote, authenticated attacker with administrative privilege to inject arbitrary commands as a 'nobody' user.

item.title: CVE-2020-11023 — JQuery JQuery
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JQuery contains a persistent cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. When passing maliciously formed, untrusted input enclosed in HTML tags, JQuery's DOM manipulators can execute untrusted code in the context of the user's browser.

item.title: CVE-2024-43572 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows Management Console contains unspecified vulnerability that allows for remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2024-43461 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Windows MSHTML Platform contains a user interface (UI) misrepresentation of critical information vulnerability that allows an attacker to spoof a web page. This vulnerability was exploited in conjunction with CVE-2024-38112.

item.title: CVE-2024-37085 — VMware ESXi
item.description: Threat Signal 69. VMware ESXi contains an authentication bypass vulnerability. A malicious actor with sufficient Active Directory (AD) permissions can gain full access to an ESXi host that was previously configured to use AD for user management by re-creating the configured AD group ('ESXi Admins' by default) after it was deleted from AD.

item.title: CVE-2023-4911 — GNU GNU C Library
item.description: Threat Signal 69. GNU C Library's dynamic loader ld.so contains a buffer overflow vulnerability when processing the GLIBC_TUNABLES environment variable, allowing a local attacker to execute code with elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2023-36844 — Juniper Junos OS
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Juniper Junos OS on EX Series contains a PHP external variable modification vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, network-based attacker to control certain, important environment variables. Using a crafted request an attacker is able to modify certain PHP environment variables, leading to partial loss of integrity, which may allow chaining to other vulnerabilities.

item.title: CVE-2023-41763 — Microsoft Skype for Business
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft Skype for Business contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation.

item.title: CVE-2021-27876 — Veritas Backup Exec Agent
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Veritas Backup Exec (BE) Agent contains a file access vulnerability that could allow an attacker to specially craft input parameters on a data management protocol command to access files on the BE Agent machine.

item.title: CVE-2020-5741 — Plex Media Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Plex Media Server contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows an attacker with access to the server administrator's Plex account to upload a malicious file via the Camera Upload feature and have the media server execute it.

item.title: CVE-2015-2291 — Intel Ethernet Diagnostics Driver for Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Intel ethernet diagnostics driver for Windows IQVW32.sys and IQVW64.sys contain an unspecified vulnerability that allows for a denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2018-18809 — TIBCO JasperReports
item.description: Threat Signal 69. TIBCO JasperReports Library contains a directory-traversal vulnerability that may allow web server users to access contents of the host system.

item.title: CVE-2022-26500 — Veeam Backup & Replication
item.description: Threat Signal 69. The Veeam Distribution Service in the Backup & Replication application allows unauthenticated users to access internal API functions. A remote attacker can send input to the internal API which may lead to uploading and executing of malicious code.

item.title: CVE-2020-3153 — Cisco AnyConnect Secure
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Cisco AnyConnect Secure Mobility Client for Windows allows for incorrect handling of directory paths. An attacker with valid credentials on Windows would be able to copy malicious files to arbitrary locations with system level privileges. This could include DLL pre-loading, DLL hijacking, and other related attacks.

item.title: CVE-2020-36193 — PEAR Archive_Tar
item.description: Threat Signal 69. PEAR Archive_Tar Tar.php allows write operations with directory traversal due to inadequate checking of symbolic links. PEAR stands for PHP Extension and Application Repository and it is an open-source framework and distribution system for reusable PHP components with known usage in third-party products such as Drupal Core and Red Hat Linux.

item.title: CVE-2017-6862 — NETGEAR Multiple Devices
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Multiple NETGEAR devices contain a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for authentication bypass and remote code execution.

item.title: CVE-2011-0609 — Adobe Flash Player
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Adobe Flash Player contains an unspecified vulnerability that allows remote attackers to execute code or cause denial-of-service (DoS).

item.title: CVE-2016-0984 — Adobe Flash Player and AIR
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Use-after-free vulnerability in Adobe Flash Player and Adobe AIR allows attackers to execute code.

item.title: CVE-2015-2419 — Microsoft Internet Explorer
item.description: Threat Signal 69. JScript in Microsoft Internet Explorer allows remote attackers to execute remote code or cause a denial of service (memory corruption) via a crafted web site.

item.title: CVE-2021-21973 — VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation
item.description: Threat Signal 69. VMware vCenter Server and Cloud Foundation Server contain a SSRF vulnerability due to improper validation of URLs in a vCenter Server plugin. This allows for information disclosure.

item.title: CVE-2021-36934 — Microsoft Windows
item.description: Threat Signal 69. If a Volume Shadow Copy (VSS) shadow copy of the system drive is available, users can read the SAM file which would allow any user to escalate privileges to SYSTEM level.

item.title: CVE-2021-25297 — Nagios Nagios XI
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Nagios XI contains a vulnerability which can lead to OS command injection on the Nagios XI server.

item.title: CVE-2018-13383 — Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy
item.description: Threat Signal 69. A heap buffer overflow in Fortinet FortiOS and FortiProxy may cause the SSL VPN web service termination for logged in users.

item.title: CVE-2019-0211 — Apache HTTP Server
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Apache HTTP Server, with MPM event, worker or prefork, code executing in less-privileged child processes or threads (including scripts executed by an in-process scripting interpreter) could execute code with the privileges of the parent process (usually root) by manipulating the scoreboard.

item.title: CVE-2019-0541 — Microsoft MSHTML
item.description: Threat Signal 69. Microsoft MSHTML engine contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution vulnerability.

item.title: CVE-2018-2380 — SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
item.description: Threat Signal 69. SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users.
